name: unity-emu-lab
description: MCP server and CLI to self-test Unity builds on Windows, macOS and Linux: Android on an emulator shared by several AI sessions through a lease (Unity-aware smoke checks, notification shade, device clock), WebGL in a local Chrome, Edge or Chromium, batchmode Unity builds with a project guard that reverts only what the build changed, and a host check.

scripts.version: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=require('./package.json').version;const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('server.json','utf8'));s.version=v;for(const p of s.packages)p.version=v;fs.writeFileSync('server.json',JSON.stringify(s,null,2)+'\n')" && git add server.json
